name: Fort Benning
tagline: The Army's Maneuver Center of Excellence, home of the Infantry and Armor, near Columbus.
_note: Army training post (Columbus GA, on the Alabama line). Name history: Fort Benning -> Fort Moore (2023) -> Fort Benning (March 2025, now honoring WWI Cpl. Fred G. Benning, not the Confederate general). Facts verified from official sources (home.army.mil/benning, martin.tricare.mil, DeCA/AAFES). BAH MHA GA075 (Fort Benning) via the bah_rates single source of truth. Housing operated by The Michaels' Organization (Heritage Landing - Fort Benning). Corrected 2026-11-10 from the website-page research (Base Guides/page-builder/research/benning-facts.md): housing operator was wrongly Balfour Beatty and the source was a third-party site (fortbenninghousing.com, 'not an official military website'); DoWEA runs five PK-8 schools on post (the guide said no DoDEA); Midland is mostly Columbus/Muscogee, not Harris County; Georgia vs Alabama tax decision added (2026 GA and 2025 AL millage, our estimates); gates from the official card; pending FY2027 NDAA name amendment noted. Removed the REAL ID line (the official visitor page says no states are under REAL ID enforcement) and the unverified 'longest urban whitewater course' claim. Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx), representative off-base ZIP 31909 (Columbus).

data.Location: Columbus, GA (the Tri-Community with Phenix City, AL)
data.Schools: U.S. Army Infantry School and Armor School
data.Also hosts: 75th Ranger Regiment, 1st Security Force Assistance Brigade, WHINSEC, Army Marksmanship Unit
data.Note: Renamed from Fort Moore back to Fort Benning on March 3, 2025 (new namesake); a June 2026 House committee amendment would restore Fort Moore (no final action found as of Nov 10, 2026)

sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Fort Benning is home to the Maneuver Center of Excellence and the Armor and Infantry schools, with the Airborne and Ranger Training Brigade (Airborne School), Officer Candidate School and the 198th Infantry, 194th Armored and 316th Cavalry brigades. It also hosts the 75th Ranger Regiment, the 1st Security Force Assistance Brigade, the Western Hemisphere Institute for Security Cooperation and the Army Marksmanship Unit.

It is part of what the Army calls the Tri-Community of Columbus, Georgia and Phenix City, Alabama. The post carried the name Fort Moore from 2023 to 2025 before reverting to Fort Benning on March 3, 2025, now honoring Cpl. Fred G. Benning, a World War I Distinguished Service Cross recipient. In June 2026 the House Armed Services Committee voted 29-27 to restore the Fort Moore name in the FY2027 defense bill; as of November 10, 2026 we found no final action.

source.label: Fort Benning Garrison About (official); army.mil (Mar 3, 2025); Military Times (Jun 5, 2026)

sections.title: Georgia or Alabama? The Fort Benning Decision

data.subtitle: The Chattahoochee River is also the state line, and property tax, vehicle tax, sales tax and the school system all change across it. On our estimates a home with a $100,000 market value carries about $590 a year in property tax in Phenix City against about $1,566 in Columbus, before exemptions.
intro: Alabama assesses a home you live in at 10% of value, Georgia at 40%. On our estimates the combined rates are about 39 mills in Columbus Urban Service District 1 (2026), about 28.6 in unincorporated Harris County (2026), about 59 in Phenix City and about 46 in Smiths Station (2025, the latest Alabama posted; Smiths Station assumes a Lee County school tax district we could not confirm). Columbus's homestead exemption cuts $13,500 of assessed value and freezes the assessment.

Alabama exempts military retirement pay from income tax and taxes vehicles every year, though military members stationed there may keep their home-state registration. Georgia charges a one-time vehicle title tax instead, which nonresident service members don't pay (form PT-472NS). Sales tax: Columbus 9%, Harris County 8%, Phenix City 9.75%, Smiths Station about 9% (confirm locally).

recommendations.advice: Columbus (about 16 minutes to Martin Army Community Hospital with no traffic, typical home value $175,906) and Phenix City, Alabama (about 18 minutes, $212,365) have the shortest drives and lowest typical home values (Zillow, Sept 2026).

Harris County posted the higher 2025 Georgia School Grades single score here (84.1, against 69.3 for Muscogee), with typical homes of about $383,000 to $385,000 in Cataula and Hamilton and a 34 to 46 minute drive. Most of Midland is in Columbus and Muscogee County, so confirm by address. In Alabama, Lee County Schools (Smiths Station) earned a B (87), the highest score of the three Alabama districts here.

On-post housing is run by The Michaels' Organization (Heritage Landing - Fort Benning): 4,001 homes in ten communities, with waits of up to three months. Living on post is the only way to use the five on-post DoD schools.
Columbus has the lowest typical home value of the towns we compared, but Georgia's property tax on it is higher than Alabama's, so compare the full monthly cost before you choose a side.

source.label: Georgia DOR; Alabama DOR; Columbus, Muscogee and Harris County 2026 millage; Zillow (Sept 2026)

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: Open 24 hours: I-185/Lindsey Creek Parkway, 8th Division Road (Harmony Church) and Eddy Bridge (Lawson Army Airfield). Legacy Boulevard is open 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, Custer Road (Sand Hill and Patton Village) weekdays 5 a.m. to 5 p.m. (closed weekends and federal holidays), and Buena Vista Road is outbound only.

The Visitor Control Center on Lindsey Creek Parkway is open 24 hours. A visitor pass requires a background check for everyone 18 or older in the vehicle. Military Police desk: 706-545-5223. Hours change, so confirm before you go.

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: On-post family housing is run by The Michaels' Organization as Heritage Landing - Fort Benning: 4,001 family homes in ten communities. Norton Court is being rebuilt (work began in May 2026, replacing 112 homes built in 1949). The Housing Office warns of waits of up to three months; you join the list by rank, bedroom need and the communities you choose.

Heritage Landing: (706) 685-3939; Welcome Center: 601 Lumpkin Street. Army Housing Division: (706) 545-3921. Emergency housing hotline: (706) 626-2002. Inspect for mold, leaks and pests before you sign: a July 2026 report from Sen. Jon Ossoff's office included Fort Benning families' accounts of mold, lead and cockroaches.

source.label: DoD 2026 BAH Rates, MHA GA075 (Fort Benning)

sections.title: Schools
data: DoWEA (formerly DoDEA) lists five schools on post for pre-K through grade 8, and only families living on Fort Benning can attend. There is no on-post high school: on-post students may attend Spencer High (Muscogee County), Chattahoochee County High or Russell County High, with transportation provided.

Off post: Muscogee County (Columbus) scored 69.3 on Georgia's 2025 School Grades single score and Harris County 84.1 (Georgia 78.0), with class of 2025 graduation rates of 96.09% and 94.87%. In Alabama, Phenix City Schools earned a B (85), Russell County B (84) and Lee County (Smiths Station) B (87) for 2024-25. School Support Services: (706) 545-2034. Confirm the district for any address.

data.Care: Hospital on post with inpatient and outpatient care and an emergency room

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves, and the answer is mostly about how long you'll be here and how steady the local market is.
rent: Your tour is short (about two years or less) or you're here for a course.
You want time to learn the area before committing to a neighborhood.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing when you PCS out.
Your BAH comfortably covers rent in the areas you'd consider.
buy: You expect to be here three or more years.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity instead of paying rent.
The affordable Columbus market fits your budget for a home you like.
You've found a neighborhood and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. Home prices around Columbus are low, but property tax differs a lot between Georgia and Alabama, so compare the full monthly cost. Run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, weigh your tour length, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book on-base lodging or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your unit and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Check on-base availability (and waitlist) and get the housing office's read on off-base neighborhoods before you sign anything.

steps.title: Register your vehicle and sort access
steps.text: Handle base access and the visitor-pass process for guests. In Georgia, nonresident service members don't pay the vehicle title tax (form PT-472NS); in Alabama, military members stationed there may keep their home-state registration.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Families living on post use the five DoWEA schools (pre-K to grade 8); otherwise contact the gaining district (Muscogee, Harris, Phenix City, Russell or Lee County) early and bring records and immunizations. School Support Services: (706) 545-2034.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at Martin Army Community Hospital or network providers.

data.q: Is it Fort Benning or Fort Moore?
data.a: Fort Benning, as of March 3, 2025. It was Fort Moore from 2023 to 2025; the name now honors a World War I corporal, Fred G. Benning, rather than the Confederate general. In June 2026 the House Armed Services Committee voted 29-27 to restore the Fort Moore name in the FY2027 defense bill; as of November 10, 2026 we found no final action.

It's home to the Maneuver Center of Excellence and the Armor and Infantry schools, with Airborne and Ranger training, Officer Candidate School, the 75th Ranger Regiment and the 1st Security Force Assistance Brigade.

Columbus and Phenix City (Alabama, across the river) are closest, with the lowest typical home values. Harris County posted the higher Georgia school score, and Lee County (Smiths Station) the highest Alabama score here. On-post housing has 4,001 homes, with waits of up to three months.

data.q: Are there DoD schools on post?
data.a: Yes. DoWEA lists five schools on Fort Benning for pre-K through grade 8, for families living on post. On-post high schoolers may attend Spencer, Chattahoochee County or Russell County High, with transportation provided.
Fort Benning is MHA GA075. Use the calculator above for your grade.
